title: My Best Friend
text:
My friend Ana is very kind. She is also funny, and she makes me laugh. She is shy with new people, but she is friendly with her friends.

Ana is very smart. She likes to read books, and she helps me with my homework. Her brother Pedro is different. He is loud and he likes sports.

questions.text: What does Ana like to do?
What kind of friend is Ana?
Which activity would Pedro probably enjoy most?

vocabulary.definition: friendly and caring toward other people
not comfortable talking to people you do not know
school work that you do at home

paragraph_translations: Minha amiga Ana é muito gentil. Ela também é engraçada, e me faz rir. Ela é tímida com pessoas novas, mas é simpática com as amigas.
Ana é muito inteligente. Ela gosta de ler livros, e me ajuda com o dever de casa. Seu irmão Pedro é diferente. Ele é barulhento e gosta de esportes.
